question: What ash and fixed carbon contents, on an air-dried basis, did the sewage sludge used for carbide slag-assisted steam gasification have?
rendered: According to Table 1, the sewage sludge used for carbide slag-assisted steam gasification had an ash content of 9.02 wt % and a fixed carbon content of 12.39 wt %, on an air-dried basis.
